item.content:encoded:
Welcome to the AI renaissance

Get lost in the past to incubate ideas for the future.

Join a small, curated group of researchers, builders, entrepreneurs, politicians, and artists for a 10-day unconference focused on the political economy of AI. We will build new infrastructure, business models, and institutions for AI.

  • Dates: June 14-24, 2026

  • Location: Bückeburg Palace, Germany (1 hour outside of Hanover)

  • Style: unconference

  • Number of attendees: ~35

  • Costs: None, accommodation and food included

What are the new (and old) business models of AI?

What would it look like to open-source or decentralize layers of the AI stack?

What new institutions will shape the future of the AI industry?

During the 10-day residency we will probe these and other questions, challenging each other’s assumptions and our own assumptions. We’ll debate guidelines, philosophies, business models, and standards. We might even build prototypes, write white papers, and launch new companies.

You can find more questions contributed by last year’s participants here.

Join Us

June 14-24, 2026

Feel free to DM one of us (see below) and tell us why this event can’t happen without you!

The Team

  • Joshua Tan

    MONK OF MANY WORLDS

    Math+CS, public AI, founder Metagov

  • Donatus (Teddy) Schaumburg-Lippe

    DAUPHIN DE AI

    Activator of projects, House of Schaumburg-Lippe, founder AIR

  • Primavera di Filippi

    WIZARD OF VIBES

    Extitutional being, legal hacker & artist, permanent researcher CNRS + Harvard

  • Nick Vincent

    LEVERSMITH

    Professor of data pipelines; building levers so we can all copilot AI

  • Alex Krasodomski

    DARK CHANCELLOR

    Government whisperer, tech policy director at Chatham House

  • Jacob Taylor

    MASTER OF ROOMS

    Policy maven, collective intelligence, fellow at Brookings

The Location

Built over 700 years ago, the Bueckeburg Palace in Germany still serves as the home for the royal family of Schaumburg-Lippe, once reigning princes over the small sovereign state of the same name.

Throughout the years, it has hosted artists, dictators, rebels, scientists, entrepreneurs, and several historical figures including Napoleon Bonaparte, Kaiser Wilhelm the Second, and Mikhael Gorbachev.

Through war and peace, through revolutions political and technological, it has served as a reminder that history is ever-changing and that power is meant to be challenged.

The Memories

item.title: Sponsor
item.content:encoded:
SponsorSHIP packages

AI Renaissance is a 10-day unconference focused on the political economy of AI. We foster deep relationships, build open-source infrastructure, and brainstorm new institutions and business models for the AI economy. It takes place every year at Bückeburg Palace, Germany, just an hour outside of Hanover.

Who’s been here: Previous years have brought together researchers from HuggingFace, Anthropic, Mila, Oxford, and Stanford alongside policymakers from the Bundestag and the European Parliament, and leadership from civil society organizations like the Bertelsmann Foundation, Future of Life Institute, Chatham House, and the Collective Intelligence Project. For 10 days, you are working directly with the people actively shaping AI in the world.

Sponsoring AIR: As an event conceived and organized for the public benefit, AI Renaissance is only possible with the support of sponsors. Sponsorship and participation can be an excellent value for companies, foundations, and investors that benefit from (or want to explore the benefits of) open source, decentralized, and public AI. Previous sponsors have ranged from government agencies to large tech companies to individual investors. Note that only a limited number of sponsorships are available each year, based on the number of available VIP rooms.

PATRON

Price: 1500 EUROS.

Join us in the palace for an incredible week of conversations, food, and play. Benefits include:

  • A guaranteed ticket for yourself or a person of your choosing.

    Previous years of AI Renaissance have been attended by many leading researchers, technologists, entrepreneurs, artists, and policymakers in AI, including ones from the HuggingFace, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, the European Parliament, ELLIS, LAION, Oxford, Stanford, Harvard, as well as the leadership of many civil society groups such as Creative Commons, the Collective Intelligence Project, Foresight Institute, Future of Life Institute, Public Knowledge, and so on.

  • A reserved standard bed in the palace for the entire duration of the event, valued at over 1500 euros.

  • Each ticket guarantees you 3 meals a day for the duration of the event prepared by our Michelin-trained private chefs.

  • We’ll express our gratitude on our website and promotional materials.

VILLA

Price: 5000 EUROS.

Bring your collaborators, and sleep like Napoleon Bonaparte. Benefits include:

  • One VIP ticket, plus one Patron tickets for an additional guest or collaborator.

    Previous years of AI Renaissance have been attended by many leading researchers, technologists, entrepreneurs, artists, and policymakers in AI, including ones from the HuggingFace, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, the European Parliament, ELLIS, LAION, Oxford, Stanford, Harvard, as well as the leadership of many civil society groups such as Creative Commons, the Collective Intelligence Project, Foresight Institute, Future of Life Institute, Public Knowledge, and so on.

  • Your own luxurious room in the palace for the duration of the event. Previous occupants include Napoleon Bonaparte, Kaiser Wilhelm II, and Mikhail Gorbachev.

  • Each ticket guarantees you 3 meals a day for the duration of the event prepared by our Michelin-trained private chefs.

  • We will organize a dedicated workshop or talk on a subject of your choosing at AI Renaissance.

  • We’ll express our gratitude on our website, all official communications, and on social media.

  • One of the dinners will be officially acknowledged as sponsored by you.

  • Sponsorship qualifies as a charitable donation to Metagov, a 501c3 nonprofit in the USA.

PALACE

Price: 15000 EUROS.

Palace-level sponsors work with us to shape AI Renaissance as a whole. It often doubles as an all-inclusive small company retreat or engineering sprint. Benefits include:

  • Including tickets, nominations, VIP rooms, meals, and sponsored dinner.

  • A roast by the other workshop participants on a project or proposal of your choosing. Very popular.

  • In addition to two dedicated workshops, a set-aside day during the week to discuss topics relevant to you, along with organizer support to make it happen.

  • The organizers will work with select attendees to generate a pre-agreed deliverable (e.g. a working paper, a policy memo, or shared dataset) from the workshop, so that your investment creates tangible outcomes.

  • We’ll help you curate additional invitees and topics, including dedicated time by the AI Renaissance organizers.

  • Sponsorship qualifies as a charitable donation to Metagov, a 501c3 nonprofit in the USA.

FOUNDER

Price: ???

For organizations that give two or more years in a row at any level.

  • Pick your room!

  • Work with the organizers to nominate and select early invitees.

  • We’ll express our gratitude on our website, all official communications, and on social media.

Contact us

Please contact the organizers if you are interested in supporting the event at any level, or if you have any questions.

FAQs

When and where is AI Renaissance?

It takes place every year at Bückeburg Palace, Germany, just an hour outside of Hanover. This year, AI Renaissance will run for 10 days from August 1-10.

Is my sponsorship tax-deductible?

All sponsorships are tax deductible as charitable donations to Metagov, a 501c3 nonprofit in the US.

Who attends the event?

Previous years of the event have been attended by many leading researchers, technologists, entrepreneurs, artists, and policymakers in AI, including ones from the HuggingFace, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, the European Parliament, ELLIS, LAION, Oxford, Stanford, Harvard, as well as the leadership of many civil society groups such as Creative Commons, the Collective Intelligence Project, Foresight Institute, Future of Life Institute, Public Knowledge, and so on.

Who has sponsored before?

Sponsors from previous years have included the National Science Foundation, Current AI, HuggingFace, Metagov, Metaculus, the Center for Cultural Innovation, Viki Jan, BlockScience, Delphia, ID Theory, Ceramic/3Box, and Seed Club.

Who organizes AI Renaissance?

AI Renaissance is organized by Metagov, a 501c3 nonprofit in the USA, and supported by Chatham House and the royal family of Schaumburg-Lippe.

What Past Attendees Had To say

“One of the Most generative events I’ve ever attended”

"An eternal brainstorming event”

“brings together A mix of artists, creators, developers, and thinkers THat I almost never see together”

“Where we developed a new language for institutional change”

“planted the seeds for new projects and collaborations”
